scope: One-hour local comparison; this protocol freezes estimands before inspecting experimental outcomes.
independent_unit: Independently seeded world block; rigid/adaptive strategies, agent kinds, FAST/SAFE modes, checkpoints and observations within a block are dependent repeated conditions.
pre_outcome_amendment: Root confirmed main grid. Add initially-FEASIBLE condition-specific descriptive panel; retain unconditional attempted-block primary. Strict sigma=1 controls remain separate from research sigma=3. Optional-objective acceptance differs by policy design and is not proof of a general navigation advantage.
directed_cases: Keep separately; corridor-conditioned threshold cases demonstrate mechanisms and their frequencies do not estimate the broad ensemble.

estimands.primary: Mean within-world ADAPTIVE minus RIGID difference in analytical completion credit, first averaging equally over the four frozen agent/mode conditions; then equally weight all planned sector/family/size strata when covered.
estimands.completion_credit: 1 only when primary_completed and returned are both true, resource_violation and reserve_violation are both explicitly false, and unknown is explicitly false; otherwise 0. UNKNOWN/no initial route are no-credit outcomes, not demonstrated physical failures.
secondary: Paired difference in optional_completed count, within-world condition mean, with unavailable episode values explicitly retained as missing rather than imputed discoveries.
Any directed-return/resource/reserve violation by strategy and condition; missing safety evidence remains unknown.
Meaningful adaptive decision changes based on geometry or work eligibility, rather than route identifiers alone.
Initial feasibility, UNKNOWN, computational limits, censored/unexecuted conditions and map unavailability in all attempted and planned blocks.
Paired condition-specific completion credit and discordant outcome counts.

denominators.primary: Complete attempted broad blocks containing all four frozen conditions and both recorded strategies; UNKNOWN episodes remain in the denominator with zero credit.
denominators.pending_or_incomplete: Do not silently treat work not executed before deadline as physical failure; list all missing planned blocks/conditions and report coverage.
denominators.public_map_unavailable: Report explicitly; do not substitute a more favorable map or fabricate an environment.
denominators.standardization: Equal weights over planned sector x family x side_m strata; if any planned stratum lacks complete blocks the full planned-target estimate is unavailable, and a clearly labelled covered-strata estimate is secondary.

uncertainty.method: Stratified paired cluster bootstrap: resample whole independent world blocks with replacement within sector x family x side_m, retaining both strategies and every agent/mode condition together. Report empirical 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles and actual stratum counts.
uncertainty.interpretation: Monte Carlo sensitivity to the declared synthetic sampling design and frozen model; neither a probability of discoveries on Mars nor a statement about unmodelled hazards.
uncertainty.small_or_degenerate: Flag strata with fewer than two blocks and degenerate bootstrap intervals. A point interval from identical cases is not evidence of universal behavior.
uncertainty.binary_condition_checks: Optional exact two-sided McNemar/binomial calculation on discordant pairs, one episode condition per independent world. No pooled checkpoint-level or mode-level significance tests.
uncertainty.proportions: Wilson intervals only for explicit independent binary world-level descriptive indicators; retain denominators and avoid interpreting them as Mars event probabilities.
uncertainty.multiplicity: One primary estimand; all conditions, families, optional work, safety and mechanism comparisons are descriptive/exploratory. Report all signs and all strata; no selection of only beneficial cases.

validation: Reject conflicting duplicate block identities and duplicate condition keys.
Preserve provenance and world hashes; never use strategy/mode repetition as extra independent worlds.
Reject impossible booleans/counts and nonfinite statistics; require explicit safety fields for completion credit.
Verify paired calculations against small controls containing improvement, deterioration, UNKNOWN and missing conditions.
Export exact input SHA256, protocol SHA256, script SHA256, software versions, exclusions and outcome tables.
